[Gazette of Pakistan,

F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub. dated
3-10-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Amendment of certain laws.--The
laws specified in the schedule shall be amended in the manner specified in the
fourth column thereof.

1.
XXIV of 1974
The Centres of Excellence Act,
1974
After section 9, the following
new section shall be inserted namely:--
"9-A. Power to transfer
Centres.--The Federal Government may by Order published in the official
Gazette and subject to such terms and conditions as it may think fit to
impose, transfer any Centre to a University or, as the case may be, the
Provincial Government."
2.
XLV of 1975
The Area Study, Centres Act,
1975
After section 9 the following
new section shall be inserted, namely:-?
"9-A. Power to transfer
Centres.--The Federal Government may, by Order published in the official
Gazette and subject to such conditions as may be specified therein, transfer
any. Centre to a University or, as the case may be, the Provincial
Government."
3.
XXVII of 1976
The Pakistan Study Centres,
Act, 1976
After section 10, the following
new section shall be inserted, namely:-?
"10AA. Power to
transfer Centres.-? The Federal Government may, by Order published in the

therein, transfer any Centre to a University or, as the case may be the
Provincial Government. "
